papers.title_en: DomeGS: Perceptually Consistent Background Completion for Unbounded 3D Gaussian Splatting in Virtual Reality
papers.authors: Anastasiya Pechko, Agata Szymańska, Piotr Borycki, Joanna Szelewska, Michał Mnich, Sławomir Tadeja, Przemysław Spurek
papers.evidence: 面向无界户外场景的3D高斯泼溅渲染
papers.tldr: 针对VR无界户外3DGS重建中地平线缺失、传统skybox与几何难融合的问题，DomeGS将skydome纳入高斯场景重建，统一整合天空与远景。该方法把地平线和天空作为3DGS表示的一部分，构建前后景连贯的场景一致环境。36名用户实验显示，相较skybox基线，空间临场感与真实感均显著提升（p=0.042）。这为VR无界场景提供感知一致的背景补全方案，有助于增强沉浸感。
papers.abstract_en: The growing need for high-quality 3D content remains among the most prevalent challenges in virtual reality (VR). Recently, novel view synthesis techniques have enabled rapid content creation, with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) emerging as one of the most promising methods for generating high-fidelity 3D scenes. However, using 3DGS to reconstruct unbounded outdoor scenes can leave horizons incomplete due to missing data or a lack of distant geometric constraints. Such incompleteness can break immersion, compromising VR's core characteristic. A typical workaround in traditional VR systems is a textured cube (skybox) or sphere (skydome) surrounding the environment to create the illusion of a distant background. However, these approaches struggle to blend seamlessly with the reconstructed 3DGS geometry. To address these issues, we introduce the DomeGS framework, which incorporates the skydome concept not as a flat background shell, but as a part of the reconstructed Gaussian Splatting 3D scene. By integrating the horizon and sky into the 3DGS representation, our method provides a unified, scene-consistent environment bridging foregrounds and backgrounds for greater realism. Experimental evaluation with N=36 users demonstrates that DomeGS significantly increases spatial presence (p=0.042) and realism (p=0.042) compared to the skybox baseline.

papers.title_en: Honeycomb-Surfels: Compact Hexagonal Primitives for Efficient Scene Rendering and Reconstruction
papers.authors: Prakhar Kaushik, Soumava Paul, Alan Yuille
papers.evidence: 面向高效三维场景渲染与重建的六边形紧凑泼溅基元
papers.tldr: 针对辐射场与泼溅表示内存和计算开销大的问题，本文提出Hexels：带一阶空间颜色场的平面六边形表面基元，用更少更大的局部平面基元表达平滑变化外观。在34个场景中，其PSNR较内存匹配的2DGS提升4.53–7.38 dB且训练显存更低；重建误差在15个DTU扫描上降低28.9%。该方法在质量—效率权衡上推进了Pareto前沿。
papers.abstract_en: Novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction have advanced rapidly with radiance fields and splatting, yet their memory and computational demands limit their use in resource-constrained settings. We introduce Hexels: novel planar hexagonal surface elements with a first-order spatial color field for efficient 3D scene and 2D image representation. Hexels exploit locally planar regions with smoothly varying appearance using fewer, larger primitives. Their hexagonal support provides an area- and boundary-efficient domain, while the local color field captures appearance variation within each primitive. Across 34 scenes, Hexels improve PSNR over memory-matched 2DGS by 4.53-7.38 dB across datasets while requiring lower training VRAM. We further ablate Hexels by showing that per primitive, Hexels outperform 2DGS by upto 4.74 dB while using lower training VRAM and having 2.31 times faster FPS. Even in unconstrained settings, Hexels offers complementary quality-memory trade-offs. For efficient 3D surface reconstruction, Hexels reduce error by 28.9% compared with memory-matched 2DGS across 15 DTU scans. On 6 Tanks and Temples surface scenes, Hexels achieves the highest mean F1 among compared methods (34.38%, versus 31.72% for 2DGS). We further also show that Hexels, as a general primitive, improves 2D image representation over Image-GS. Hexels push the Pareto frontier on the quality-efficiency trade-off of surface-aligned primitives.
